note: Starts a sentence: 'so/then'. Not 咁 gam3 'so (very)'.

ex.r: gam2 ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 gin3 laa1
ex.en: Then let's meet tomorrow.

ex.r: gam2 ngo5 maai5 ni1 gin6 laa1
ex.en: Then I'll buy this one.

ex.r: m4 hou2 gam2 gong2 laa1
ex.en: Don't talk like that.

ex.r: ngo5 gei2 hou2 aa3 nei5 ne1
ex.en: I'm pretty good, and you?

ex.r: ngo5 ge3 so2 si4 ne1
ex.en: Where are my keys?

ex.r: gam1 maan5 sik6 me1 hou2 ne1
ex.en: What should we eat tonight?

ex.r: ngo5 dou1 soeng2 heoi3
ex.en: I want to go too.

ex.r: keoi5 dei6 cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 ji1 sang1
ex.en: They're all doctors.

ex.r: ngo5 jat1 di1 dou1 m4 gui6
ex.en: I'm not tired at all.

note: Adds 'you know' emphasis; in questions sounds surprised or checking.

ex.r: ni1 dou6 di1 je5 hou2 gwai3 gaa3
ex.en: Things here are really expensive, you know.

ex.r: nei5 dim2 gaai2 wui5 hai2 dou6 gaa3
ex.en: Why are you here?

ex.r: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 lou5 po4 lai4 gaa3
ex.en: She's my wife.

note: Spoken 'not'; Mandarin 不 isn't used in speech.

ex.r: ngo5 m4 sik6 laat6
ex.en: I don't eat spicy food.

ex.r: m4 goi1 ngo5 m4 jiu3 doi2
ex.en: No bag for me, thanks.

ex.r: gam1 jat6 hou2 dung3 ngo5 m4 soeng2 ceot1 gaai1
ex.en: It's cold today, I don't want to go out.

note: Softens requests and suggestions.

ex.r: faai3 di1 laa1 zau6 lai4 ci4 dou3 laa3
ex.en: Hurry up, we're about to be late!

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 jam2 caa4 laa1
ex.en: Let's go for dim sum.

ex.s: 你坐低先啦，我好快返嚟。
ex.r: nei5 co5 dai1 sin1 laa1 ngo5 hou2 faai3 faan1 lai4
ex.en: Have a seat, I'll be right back.

note: Most common measure word; 個 + noun can also mean 'the'.

ex.r: ngo5 soeng2 jiu3 jat1 go3 hon3 bou2 baau1
ex.en: I'd like a hamburger.

ex.s: 個天好黑呀，就快落雨喇。
ex.r: go3 tin1 hou2 hak1 aa3 zau6 faai3 lok6 jyu5 laa3
ex.en: The sky's really dark, it's about to rain.

ex.r: keoi5 jau5 loeng5 go3 zai2
ex.en: He has two sons.

ex.r: ngo5 jau5 jat1 go3 sai3 lou2
ex.en: I have a younger brother.

ex.r: ni1 dou6 jau5 hou2 do1 caan1 teng1
ex.en: There are lots of restaurants here.

ex.r: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jau5 si4 gaan3
ex.en: I have time tomorrow.

note: Plural/uncountable measure word; after an adjective = 'a bit more': 快啲.

ex.r: di1 sung3 hou2 hou2 sik6
ex.en: The dishes are really tasty.

ex.r: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 gong2 maan6 di1 aa3
ex.en: Could you speak a bit slower?

ex.r: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 di1 saang1 gwo2
ex.en: I want to buy some fruit.

note: 又…又… = both…and….

ex.r: nei5 jau6 ci4 dou3 laa3
ex.en: You're late again!

ex.r: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 jau6 peng4 jau6 hou2 sik6
ex.en: This restaurant is cheap and tasty.

ex.r: gam1 jat6 jau6 lok6 jyu5
ex.en: It's raining again today.

ex.r: ngo5 waa6 zo2 bei2 nei5 zi1 gaa3 laa3
ex.en: I already told you.

ex.r: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 jiu3 jau1 sik1 gei2 jat6
ex.en: The doctor said I need to rest a few days.

note: Marks a completed action; replaces Mandarin 了.

ex.r: nei5 sik6 zo2 faan6 mei6 aa3
ex.en: Have you eaten yet?

ex.r: ngo5 maai5 zo2 bou6 san1 sau2 gei1

ex.r: keoi5 ji5 ging1 faan1 zo2 uk1 kei2 laa3

en: to not have; there isn't; didn't

ex.r: syut3 gwai6 mou5 ngau4 naai5 laa3
ex.en: There's no milk left in the fridge.

ex.r: ngo5 cam4 maan5 mou5 fan3 hou2
ex.en: I didn't sleep well last night.

ex.r: ting1 jat6 wui5 lok6 jyu5
ex.en: It's going to rain tomorrow.

ex.r: ngo5 gam1 maan5 wui5 maan5 di1 faan1
ex.en: I'll be home a bit late tonight.

ex.r: nei5 wui5 m4 wui5 gong2 jing1 man2
ex.en: Can you speak English?

note: Measure word: 個.

ex.r: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 hou2 do1 jan4
ex.en: This restaurant is really crowded.

ex.r: keoi5 hai6 go3 hou2 jan4
ex.en: He's a good person.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 jau5 ng5 sap6 go3 jan4
ex.en: Our company has fifty people.

ex.r: nei5 heoi3 bin1 aa3
ex.en: Where are you going?

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 heoi3 ciu1 si5 maai5 je5
ex.en: We're going to the supermarket tomorrow.

ex.r: ngo5 hou2 soeng2 heoi3 jat6 bun2 leoi5 hang4
ex.en: I really want to travel to Japan.

note: Marks something new: 'now, already'. 夠喇 = that's enough.

ex.r: sik6 faan6 laa3 faai3 di1 lai4
ex.en: Dinner's ready, come quickly!

ex.r: ngo5 baau2 laa3 m4 goi1
ex.en: I'm full now, thanks.

ex.r: ngo5 jiu3 zau2 laa3 ting1 jat6 gin3
ex.en: I have to go now, see you tomorrow.

note: Gives an obvious reason: 'after all, you know'.

ex.r: ngo5 m4 heoi3 laa3 lok6 gan2 jyu5 maa3
ex.en: I'm not going, it's raining after all.

ex.r: keoi5 hou2 gui6 zou6 zo2 jat1 jat6 je5 maa3
ex.en: He's tired, he worked all day, you know.

ex.r: peng4 di1 laa1 ngo5 maai5 loeng5 gin6 maa3
ex.en: Make it cheaper, I'm buying two after all.

en: to speak; to talk; to say
note: 講 + language = speak it; 同…講 = tell/talk to.

ex.r: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 faai3
ex.en: She talks really fast.

ex.r: ngo5 tung4 lou5 baan2 gong2 zo2
ex.en: I talked to the boss.

ex.r: sik1 gong2 gwong2 dung1 waa2
ex.en: Diego can speak Cantonese.

note: Often shortened to 咩 me1. Mandarin 什麼.

ex.r: nei5 soeng2 sik6 mat1 je5 aa3
ex.en: What do you want to eat?

ex.r: nei5 zou6 mat1 je5 gung1 gaa3
ex.en: What do you do for work?

ex.r: faat3 sang1 mat1 je5 si6
ex.en: What happened?

note: 買嘢 shop, 食嘢 eat, 做嘢 work. Replaces Mandarin 東西.

ex.r: ngo5 heoi3 maai5 di1 je5
ex.en: I'm going to buy some stuff.

ex.r: nei5 sik6 zo2 je5 mei6
ex.en: Have you eaten anything?

ex.r: ngo5 zung6 zou6 gan2 je5
ex.en: I'm still working.

ex.r: nei5 gok3 dak1 dim2 aa3
ex.en: What do you think?

ex.r: ngo5 gok3 dak1 jau5 di1 m4 syu1 fuk6
ex.en: I feel a bit unwell.

ex.r: ngo5 gok3 dak1 ni1 gin6 saam1 hou2 leng3
ex.en: I think this shirt is really nice.

note: 唔知 = don't know. For knowing people or skills use 識.

ex.en: I don't know what time he arrives.

ex.r: nei5 zi1 m4 zi1 sai2 sau2 gaan1 hai2 bin1
ex.en: Do you know where the restroom is?

ex.r: ngo5 zi1 nei5 hou2 mong4
ex.en: I know you're very busy.

en: to do; to make; to work
note: 做嘢 = to work.

ex.r: nei5 gam1 maan5 zou6 me1 aa3
ex.en: What are you doing tonight?

ex.r: ngo5 hai2 ji1 jyun2 zou6 je5
ex.en: I work at a hospital.

ex.r: ngo5 maa4 maa1 hou2 zung1 ji3 zou6 daan6 gou1
ex.en: My mom loves making cakes.

note: Result marker: 搵到 found, 見到 saw. As 'arrive' it is dou3.

ex.en: I found my wallet!

ex.r: nei5 teng1 m4 teng1 dou2 ngo5 gong2 je5
ex.en: Can you hear me?

ex.s: 我尋日喺超市見到你老公。
ex.r: ngo5 cam4 jat6 hai2 ciu1 si5 gin3 dou2 nei5 lou5 gung1
ex.en: I saw your husband at the supermarket yesterday.

note: Colloquial 'come' (Mandarin 來); many speakers say lei4.

ex.r: nei5 gei2 dim2 lai4 aa3
ex.en: What time are you coming?

ex.r: gwo3 lai4 sik6 faan6 laa1
ex.en: Come over and eat!

ex.r: faai3 di1 gaa3 baa1 si2 lai4 laa3
ex.en: Quick, the bus is coming!

note: 幾 + adjective = 'quite'; 幾點 = what time.

ex.r: ji4 gaa1 gei2 dim2 aa3
ex.en: What time is it now?

ex.r: ni1 dou6 di1 je5 gei2 hou2 sik6
ex.en: The food here is pretty good.

ex.r: ngo5 heoi3 zo2 toi4 waan1 gei2 jat6
ex.en: I went to Taiwan for a few days.

note: Needs a measure word: 嗰個, 嗰間. Mandarin 那.

ex.r: go2 go3 jan4 hai6 bin1 go3 aa3
ex.en: Who's that person?

ex.r: ngo5 soeng2 jiu3 go2 gin6 m4 goi1
ex.en: I'd like that one, please.

ex.r: go2 gaan1 hok6 haau6 hou2 kan5 ngo5 uk1 kei2
ex.en: That school is really close to my home.

ex.s: 其實我唔係好鍾意食魚。

ex.r: kei4 sat6 keoi5 jan4 gei2 hou2 gaa3
ex.en: Actually, he's quite a nice person.

ex.r: kei4 sat6 m4 sai2 gam3 zou2 ceot1 mun4
ex.en: Actually, we don't need to leave so early.

ex.r: ngo5 mei6 si3 gwo3 ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1

ex.r: ngo5 hok6 gwo3 gei2 nin4 gong3 kam4

ex.en: What's your name?

ex.r: gam1 jat6 hou2 dung3 aa3 zoek3 do1 gin6 saam1 laa1
ex.en: It's so cold today, put on another layer.

ex.r: ni1 go3 gei2 cin2 aa3
ex.en: How much is this?

note: After a verb: 食多啲 = eat more.

ex.r: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jau5 hou2 do1 je5 zou6
ex.en: I have lots to do today.

ex.r: nei5 jiu3 sik6 do1 di1 coi3
ex.en: You need to eat more vegetables.

ex.r: go2 dou6 do1 m4 do1 jan4 aa3
ex.en: Is it crowded there?

ex.r: dang2 ngo5 nam2 haa5 sin1
ex.en: Let me think about it first.

ex.r: ngo5 nam2 keoi5 gam1 jat6 m4 wui5 lai4
ex.en: I don't think he'll come today.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 nam2 zyu6 syu2 gaa3 heoi3 leoi5 hang4
ex.en: We're planning to travel in the summer holidays.

note: 點樣 = how; 點解 = why; 幾點 = what time.

ex.r: nei5 dim2 faan1 uk1 kei2 aa3
ex.en: How are you getting home?

ex.en: Take good care of yourself.

ex.r: keoi5 zi6 gei2 jat1 go3 jan4 zyu6

ex.r: do1 ze6 saai3 nei5 bong1 ngo5
ex.en: Thanks so much for helping me.

note: Often shortened to 嗰陣.

ex.en: I don't like eating this kind of food.

ex.r: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 gin3 ji1 sang1

en: is there…?; do you have…?; did you…?

ex.en: Do you have any siblings?

ex.en: Mom's asking when you're coming back.

ex.en: She doesn't like rainy days.
